## VSiN on this hire — The Coaching Carousel Never Stops

*Adam Burke, p. 32. GUIDE CONTENT — TTW reference notes summarising the guide's assessment; the judgement is the guide's.*

Adam Burke opens on the precedent: the hire of former James Madison head coach Curt Cignetti seemed to work out at Indiana, and now the Bruins' athletic department is hoping for the same with Chesney, who was at Holy Cross prior to his two seasons with the Dukes. He states the record plainly — Chesney is a winner with a career 132-52 record and took JMU to the College Football Playoff as the G5 representative last season. He then sets the bar: for a Bruins bunch that has only finished the season ranked one time since 2014, the bar isn't terribly high, so Chesney, a strong hire by all accounts, has the chance to rapidly improve the programme, even with a tough Big Ten schedule.
